Name: Simple Essentials
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]Simple Essentials[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC · Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ · SMAPI 4.4.0+[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Nineteen farming, storage and quality-of-life features combined into one mod, with individual feature switches. Choose the features you want and manage their settings together.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]✨ Included Features[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Simple Festival Speed[/b] — Move faster while freely walking at festivals.
[b]Simple Forage Helper[/b] — Use a collector to gather loose forage and dig spots each morning.
[b]Simple Forage Digging[/b] — Apply forage quality to eligible dug-up forage.
[b]Simple Auto Play[/b] — Automate selected nearby chores after manual activation.
[b]Simple Lasting Soil[/b] — Reduce daily loss of tilled and watered soil.
[b]Simple Item Lock[/b] — Mark inventory items as locked.
[b]Simple Harvest Dates[/b] — View crop harvest and last-planting dates.
[b]Simple Smart Planting[/b] — Plant seeds or apply fertilizer across multiple eligible tiles.
[b]Simple Pet Again[/b] — Repeat pet affection interactions after the daily petting.
[b]Simple Tool Charging[/b] — Adjust tool charge speed.
[b]Simple Fridge Upgrade[/b] — Expand individual fridges with upgrade kits.
[b]Simple Tool Belt[/b] — Store tools in a belt with optional smart switching.
[b]Simple Journal Expansion[/b] — See more quest entries at once.
[b]Simple NPC Paths[/b] — Show remembered NPC routes when planning placement.
[b]Simply Birthday Gifts[/b] — View liked and loved gift ideas on the birthday calendar.
[b]Simple Pouch[/b] — Carry additional items in an upgradeable pouch.
[b]Simple Chest Upgrade[/b] — Expand chest storage with upgrade kits.
[b]Simple Backpack Upgrade[/b] — Buy larger backpacks and trade in empty rows at Pierre.
[b]Simple Sprinklers Upgrade 2[/b] — Configure sprinkler ranges and watering options.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🎒 Backpack Prices & Trade-ins[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Version [b]1.4[/b] includes Backpack 1.7. The [b]Expensive[/b] default charges 250,000g for 48 slots, 750,000g for 60, 2,000,000g for 72 and 5,000,000g for 84. [b]Classic[/b] restores the old prices, [b]Extreme[/b] doubles Expensive, and [b]Custom[/b] retains individually edited tier prices. Existing custom price settings remain Custom.

Extra upgrades are [b]Off by default[/b]. Enable them to purchase further twelve-slot rows, up to your configured limit of 12,000 slots. Purchased capacity is retained when that limit is lowered.

At Pierre’s backpack display, return one empty twelve-slot row at a time, down to 36 slots. Put down any held/cursor item first. The confirmation shows the new capacity and refund. Recorded purchases return [b]50% of the amount actually paid[/b]; older or command-granted upgrades without a receipt explicitly show [b]0g[/b]. Pan Slot’s equipped pan is preserved during drawing, capacity changes and trade-ins.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#CBD5E1]Menu examples rendered with the native game interface.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54009/54009-1792525112-493521118.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Shipping Bin Inventory[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]The shipping bin automatically shows your unlocked backpack rows when the screen has room. The 48- and 60-slot upgrades can display all four or five rows without scrolling. Larger backpacks keep scrolling when needed, and your existing Visible backpack rows setting is respected.

The separate [b]+[/b] backpack page and its shortcut are unavailable while shipping. The shipping menu stays open with its side controls in place. Last-item undo remains above the backpack, and the layout adjusts when the window is resized. No extra shipping-bin setting is required.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎒 Toolbar Row Limit[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Set [b]Shift Rows Limit[/b] in the Backpack section of Generic Mod Config Menu. [b]All rows[/b] is the default. Choose [b]4 rows[/b] to cycle the toolbar through only the first four rows, or [b]5 rows[/b] for exactly five. A limit of 1 keeps the current toolbar row. Limits above your purchased row count use the rows you own. Open the dropdown and scroll within its list to choose another count, including 30 rows.

Extra storage remains accessible by scrolling. Without GMCM, close the game and set [b]Settings.Backpack.ShiftRowsLimit[/b] to [b]4[/b] in config.json; use 0 for all rows.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙ Choose Your Features[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Open Simple Essentials in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. The feature switches are at the top, with each feature’s detailed settings below. Change feature switches at the title screen and restart for them to apply. Without GMCM, edit Features and Settings in the generated config.json while the game is closed.

All features are available by default; Auto Play still needs its normal manual start.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Turning off a storage feature retains access to existing Pouch, Tool Belt, collector, fridge, chest and backpack contents. New purchases, upgrades and automatic functions stop. Feature switches do not uninstall a mod or clean a save.

When Item Lock and Pouch use the same binding, one press enables both protections if either is off, or clears both when both are on. Different bindings remain independent.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📦 Requirements & Switching from Standalone Mods[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/url]. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.

Back up your save and old mod folders. Move the matching nineteen standalone mod folders outside Mods, then extract [b]SimpleEssentials[/b] into Mods. Keep unrelated mods installed. Renaming an old folder inside Mods does not disable it.

Essentials prevents combined features from activating when it detects a matching standalone mod. Use essentials_status in the SMAPI console to view the detected state.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📥 Existing Saves & Settings[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Existing saved items and progress use their original identifiers. Old settings can be imported individually at the title screen with essentials_import; the included Quick-Start.txt explains the command and feature keys. Importing is optional and leaves the old files unchanged.

Keep your existing Essentials config.json when updating from an earlier Essentials release.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages & Compatibility[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Includes English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian. NPC Paths retains thirteen original English fallback strings.

Hoarder Chest and Storage Terminal remain separate mods. Mods that specifically require a standalone mod ID may need an Essentials adapter. Multiplayer peers should use matching Essentials versions and feature choices; mixed standalone and Essentials installations use different network mod IDs.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please post reports and ideas on this page. For bugs, include the mod version, game/SMAPI versions and platform, what happened versus what you expected, reproduction steps, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video if helpful.

For suggestions, explain what you would like changed or added and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
